Healthcare billing that matches the record

enterlabs works with medical records, bills and claim submissions, so a claim goes out with documents that agree.

Book a demoAll industries

The problem

A claim can stall when the medical record, the bill and the submission do not tell the same story.

Documents: Medical records, bills and claim submissions.

Example checks

Check 1

Match billed items to the medical record.

Check 2

Check a claim submission against the supporting bill.

Check 3

Flag missing or inconsistent documents for review.

How it works

01

Prepare the data

enterlabs reads medical records, bills and claim submissions and turns them into structured data.

02

Check against agreed rules

It matches billed items to the medical record and the claim submission to the supporting bill.

03

Review and record

A person reviews each flagged item and makes the final call. Every review is recorded.

An example screen

A medical record, a bill and a claim submission side by side. One billed item with no entry in the record is flagged for review.
